name: kneedeep
description: Street-level truth for AI agents: verified, perishable, paid.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up --build -d && echo 'KneeDeep on http://localhost:8080 (map: /map, report: /report, my activity: /me)'
scripts.demo: npm run docker:up && npm run demo:check
scripts.cre:test: cd cre/contracts && forge test && cd ../kneedeep-verify && bun test
scripts.cre:simulate: cd cre && cre workflow simulate ./kneedeep-verify --target staging-settings --non-interactive --trigger-index 0
scripts.cre:simulate:broadcast: cd cre && cre workflow simulate ./kneedeep-verify --target staging-settings --non-interactive --trigger-index 0 --broadcast
